releases.changelog: Commerce 1.1.29 marketplace build.

Admin redesign since 1.1.20.

- Dashboard cards in a row share one height.
- Fulfillment steps are named in **Edit fulfillment steps**. **Mark as** the next step advances an order. The End step fulfills it. **Record shipment** stores the carrier and tracking number.
- **Pause** and **Delete** stay in the discount sheet footer, including while adding a rule, and on each saved row.
- Gift cards open in a sheet: copy, mark used, void, make active, and set balance.
- Orders, customers, inventory, and subscriptions use the same side sheet. Docs list the full Commerce articles.

releases.changelog: User Management 1.1.22. The admin uses the Birch kit. The user list has separate avatar, name, and email cells, with edit and delete as icon buttons on the right. Permissions, tiers, and profile types open in side sheets. Signup flows and memberships choose Commerce products from menus. Each docs topic has a summary, a walk-through, and an advanced section.
User Management 1.1.12. Section cards use the frame role.
User Management 1.1.11. Dashboard lead rank is declared by the plugin. Admin screens use the kit button names.
User Management 1.1.10. Documentation covers signup flows, membership products, emails, groups, and accounts. Admin titles use catalog keys.

User calls Commerce through the shelf, imports membership products, registers its playbook, and loads each admin script once. The account example uses birkly-client.js. Requires Birkly >=1.1.0. Tag v1.1.6.

* P96-M15: one mint button per view on Site users and Permissions by @Raaakete in https://github.com/Birkly-Other-Things/Birkly-Plugin-User/pull/74

* User emails use the shared template flow by @Raaakete in https://github.com/Birkly-Other-Things/Birkly-Plugin-User/pull/76
